_about: Test personas. The runner sends 'opening', then answers each question the assistant asks using 'answers' (keyed by slot; '__type__' answers the 'which problem is it?' question). Unanswered slots get 'skip'. 'followups' are sent after intake. 'expect' drives the automatic checks. All names, companies and amounts are fictional.

cases.persona: Priya, 27, software tester renting in Bengaluru. Landlord kept the whole deposit for 'painting charges'.
cases.opening: My landlord in Bengaluru is not returning my security deposit of ₹60,000. I vacated on 15 August 2026 and he says he is keeping all of it for 'painting charges'.

answers.proof: I have the rent agreement, the bank transfer screenshot of the deposit and WhatsApp chats asking for it. No photos of the flat.

cases.practice_reply: The agreement says the deposit is refundable. Please share the itemised painting bill within 7 days. Otherwise I will send a legal notice.

cases.persona: Arjun, 29, IT employee in Pune. Resigned; two months' salary unpaid; HR says F&F takes 90 days.
cases.opening: I resigned from Zentrix Software Solutions Pvt Ltd in Pune. My last working day was 30 September 2026. They have not paid my salary for August and September, total ₹1,80,000. HR keeps saying full and final takes 90 days.

answers.their_reason: HR says company policy is 90 days for full and final
answers.proof: I have the offer letter, payslips till July, bank statements and my resignation acceptance email. HR replies are on email too.

cases.practice_reply: Policy cannot override the law. Please pay my August and September salary of Rs 1,80,000 within 7 days and confirm in writing, otherwise I will file a claim with the labour authority.

cases.persona: Rahul, 34, Delhi. Returned a phone bought on an online app; refund of Rs 8,499 never came.
cases.opening: I returned a phone I bought on QuickKart, an online shopping app, for Rs 8,499. The return pickup was done on 2 September 2026 but the refund never came. I live in Delhi.

answers.promise: Customer care said refund in 7 days, ticket number QK-55821
answers.proof: I have the invoice, the return pickup confirmation, chat screenshots and the UPI payment reference.

cases.practice_reply: Please share the refund UTR number today. It has been over a month since pickup, so I want the refund of Rs 8,499 within 7 days or I will complain to the National Consumer Helpline.

cases.persona: Vikas, 24, writes in Hinglish. Left a flat in Noida 2 months ago; Rs 25,000 deposit not returned.
cases.opening: Bhai mera makaan malik 25000 ka deposit wapas nahi kar raha. Maine Noida wala flat 2 mahine pehle chhod diya tha. Kya karu?

answers.their_reason: Bolta hai abhi paise nahi hai, baad mein dunga
answers.proof: agreement hai, deposit UPI se diya tha, photo nahi hai

cases.practice_reply: Sharma ji, agreement mein deposit refundable likha hai. 25000 rupaye 10 din mein de dijiye, warna main legal notice bhejunga.

cases.persona: Ramesh, 41, shop worker in Jaipur, writes in Hindi (Devanagari). Paid in cash, 3 months unpaid.
cases.opening: मेरे मालिक ने पिछले 3 महीने से तनख्वाह नहीं दी है। मैं जयपुर में एक कपड़े की दुकान में काम करता हूँ। हर महीने 15000 रुपये मिलते थे।

answers.amount: कुल 45000 रुपये बाकी हैं, जुलाई से सितंबर तक
answers.end_date: अभी भी काम कर रहा हूँ
answers.proof: कोई सबूत नहीं, पैसे नकद मिलते थे

cases.practice_reply: सेठ जी, मेरी 45000 रुपये तनख्वाह बाकी है। 15 दिन में दे दीजिए, नहीं तो मैं लेबर ऑफिस में शिकायत करूँगा।

cases.persona: Neha, 31, Mumbai. Washing machine order cancelled, no refund. Then asks for Supreme Court judgments to quote.
cases.opening: ShopZone, a shopping app, cancelled my order for a washing machine worth ₹32,000 on 10 October 2026 but I have not got the refund yet. I live in Mumbai.

answers.promise: They said refund in 5 to 7 working days. No ticket number.
answers.proof: I have the order confirmation email, the cancellation message and my credit card statement.

followups: Can you give me Supreme Court judgments and case law that support me? I want to quote them in my notice.

cases.persona: Anita, 35. Wants a divorce; husband took jewellery and money.
cases.opening: I want to divorce my husband. He took my jewellery and ₹2 lakh from my account. What should I do?

cases.persona: Imran, 26, Hyderabad. Landlord refuses Rs 40,000 deposit and threatened to beat him.
cases.opening: My landlord in Hyderabad is refusing to return my ₹40,000 deposit. Yesterday he threatened to beat me if I come to ask again.

answers.their_reason: He says I damaged the furniture, which is not true
answers.proof: I have the agreement and bank transfer proof, and photos when I left.

cases.persona: Kavita, 45, sales director in Gurugram. Rs 12 lakh salary and bonus unpaid.
cases.opening: I was a sales director at Orbitline Technologies in Gurugram. They owe me ₹12 lakh: 4 months salary plus bonus. I resigned on 31 July 2026.

answers.their_reason: They say the bonus is discretionary and salary is held because of an internal audit
answers.proof: Appointment letter, salary slips, bank statements, emails, resignation acceptance, everything.

cases.persona: Sourav, 21, student in a Kolkata PG. Paid deposit in cash, no agreement.
cases.opening: I paid my PG owner 30000 deposit in cash. There was no agreement. I left last month and he is not giving it back. I live in Kolkata.

answers.proof: Nothing, it was all cash, no agreement

cases.persona: Someone who types one vague line first, then explains.
cases.opening: someone owes me money please help

answers.__type__: It's my old company, they didn't pay my last month salary of 40000
answers.proof: salary slips and bank statements only

cases.persona: Lakshmi, 38, Chennai (Tamil Nadu, a state the Centre lists as having revised its tenancy law on Model Tenancy Act lines). Paid 10 months' rent as deposit, getting only part back.
cases.opening: I vacated my flat in Chennai on 1 October 2026. The owner took 10 months' rent as deposit, ₹2,50,000, and is now returning only ₹1,00,000.

answers.proof: I have the registered rent agreement, deposit paid by cheque, and handover photos. Also emails.

cases.persona: Farhan, 30, paid a gym in Mumbai for a year; gym shut down.
cases.opening: I paid ₹12,000 for a 1-year membership at FitZone Gym in Andheri, Mumbai on 5 June 2026. The gym shut down in September and they refuse to refund the remaining months.

answers.amount: Paid 12000, I want 8000 back for the remaining 8 months
answers.promise: The manager said he will see, no written promise
answers.proof: I have the payment receipt and WhatsApp messages with the manager

expect.note: Correct amount at stake is Rs 8,000 (remaining months), which the user only says if asked.

cases.persona: Selvi, writes only in Tamil script. Landlord in Chennai has not returned Rs 50,000 deposit. (Expected to be hard for offline mode.)
cases.opening: என் வீட்டு உரிமையாளர் 50000 ரூபாய் டெபாசிட்டை திருப்பித் தரவில்லை. நான் சென்னையில் இருக்கிறேன்.

cases.persona: Deepak, 33, Lucknow. Landlord already filed a case against him and he has a summons; deposit also withheld.
cases.opening: My landlord in Lucknow has filed a case against me for damages and I got a summons for 20 November 2026. He has also kept my deposit of ₹50,000.

answers.their_reason: He claims I damaged the floor
